design_archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro / Tactical SOC Minimalist

heading_scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100
heading_scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100
heading_scale.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-400 font-normal leading-relaxed

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 transition-all duration-200 hover:border-slate-700
visual_enhancers.alarm_alert_banner: animate-pulse bg-red-950/80 border-2 border-red-500/80 text-red-200 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(239,68,68,0.3)] flex items-center justify-between

url_fraud_scanner.security_meter_gauge: Circular SVG meter (1-100 scale) with dynamic needle/gradient arc. Score 80-100 = Emerald Safe, 50-79 = Amber Moderate Risk, 1-49 = Crimson Threat.
url_fraud_scanner.alarm_system: Includes visual flashing red perimeter overlay + optional HTML5 Web Audio synth siren toggle when threat score < 50 or fraud site detected.
url_fraud_scanner.quick_presets: Provide instant test URL buttons: 'Suspicious Phishing Bank', 'Malicious Crypto Drainer', 'Legitimate Enterprise Site'.

ai_content_detector.text_analysis: Text area input with word/character counter, sample loader buttons (Human Essay vs AI Generated Article).
ai_content_detector.metrics_breakdown: % AI Likelihood Gauge, Perplexity index, Burstiness score, and highlighted sentences colored by AI confidence.

phishing_email_detector.email_input: Raw email header + body text parser with pre-loaded scam samples (Fake CEO Wire Transfer, Suspicious Account Suspension, Genuine Receipt).
phishing_email_detector.red_flags: List of flagged anomalies: Deceptive Domain, High Urgency Keywords, Missing SPF/DKIM, Suspicious Links.

chatbot_widget.floating_bubble: Bottom-right glowing shield button with pulse ping status. Opens interactive security assistant chat.
chatbot_widget.capabilities: Rule-based assistant capable of analyzing URLs directly in chat, providing phishing advice, and offering security tips.

embed_code_generator.snippet_box: Syntax-highlighted script tag copy block with one-click 'Copy Snippet' button and instant Sonner toast notification.
embed_code_generator.interactive_preview: Live interactive iframe/sandbox container demonstrating how the embedded chatbot works on external websites.

key_features_ui_specs.scan_history: Filterable and searchable data table with scan type badges, risk scores, status indicators, and view analysis detail modal.

testing_attributes.rule: All key buttons, inputs, tabs, gauges, and alerts MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark-first tactical aesthetics with slate backgrounds (#070A12) and emerald/amber/crimson risk accents.
Ensure all interactive components have high contrast hover/active states.
Implement the alarm system with visual red flashing border and optional Web Audio synth siren sound when high fraud risk is detected.
Ensure copy snippet functionality provides feedback via Sonner toast notification.
Make sure the embedded script snippet preview page has an interactive live preview simulator.
Ensure standard JS React structure (.js / .jsx files as specified).
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all form controls, buttons, scanners, meters, and chat elements.
